risk_if_not_implemented: Without Test Restoration Using Sampling, data, software and system images cannot be reliably restored within required recovery objectives following a disruption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Encrypting Data At Rest
compensating_control_1.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data at rest.
compensating_control_1.justification: Encrypting Data At Rest (CRY-07) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Test Restoration Using Sampling (BCD-32.1) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Backups
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to create recurring backups of data, software and/or system images, as well as verify the integrity of these backups, to ensure the availability of the data to satisfy Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Backups (BCD-24) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Test Restoration Using Sampling (BCD-32.1) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
